sources.document_title: XFCN PZ254V-11-XX 2.54 mm Pin Header Connectors
sources.locator: Title/order code; specifications; single-row 06-position dimensions; mating-series statement
sources.evidence_extract: PZ254V-11-06P is the six-position vertical single-row 2.54 mm header. Rating is 3 A and -40 to +105 C; the exact product page gives 250 V AC/DC. The drawing gives 6.1 mm mating length, 3.0 mm tail, 0.64 mm square pin, and says it mates with XFCN PM254 single-row series.

sources.locator: Exact part heading and product-attribute rows
sources.evidence_extract: Exact PZ254V-11-06P: vertical through-hole single-row six-position 2.54 mm header; 6 mm mating pin, 2.5 mm insulator, 3 mm tail, 3 A, 250 V AC/DC, and -40 to +105 C.
